title: Design with direction.
intro: Ostrelya is an independent web design and development studio in Zagreb. We design brand identities and build websites that make it easier for people to understand what you do.

sections.title: Start with what matters.
sections.text: Before we decide what a page looks like, we ask who it is for and what they need to do there. That gives us a way to decide what belongs on the page, what comes first and where a visitor should go next.

sections.title: Design and development in the same room.
sections.text: We work from positioning and identity through to the live website. We test key screens on small and large devices and build editing tools around the pages a team actually updates.
